title: x402 batch settlement aggregates micropayments for cost-efficient onchain redemption
content:
x402 defines a **batch settlement** scheme (EVM-based) enabling high-volume, batched onchain redemption of micropayments.

**Problem it solves:** individually settling sub-cent payments onchain would cost more in gas than the payment is worth. Batching amortizes settlement cost across many payments, which is what makes granular usage-based pricing (per API call, per query) economically viable.

**Pattern:** accept many small offchain-verified payments, redeem them onchain in aggregate — the same accumulate-then-settle shape as payment channels and rollups.

Source: x402 docs introduction (https://docs.x402.org/introduction).
description: An EVM-based scheme lets sellers redeem high volumes of tiny payments in batched onchain transactions, keeping per-payment cost viable for usage-based services.
